name: Budget line split by house type or meter weights
title: SC-11-01-01 Budget line split by house type or meter weights
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a budget line allocated by house type and meter keys
When the budget is approved and dues are generated
Then each unit share follows the configured weights and the shares add up to the line total
